# LWS - Linux Web Services

> CLI tool and REST API for managing Proxmox VE hosts, LXC containers and Docker
> services over SSH. Single Python entrypoint (`lws.py`) built with Click, plus
> an optional Flask REST API (`api.py`) that wraps the CLI.

LWS is a command-line tool for Proxmox VE administrators: creating, scaling,
snapshotting, backing up and migrating LXC containers, managing Proxmox hosts
and firewall security groups, and deploying Docker workloads inside containers.
A REST API and a minimal web UI expose the same functionality over HTTP.
